meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会按BIDS规范帮你处理数据:整理神经影像等文件、查询数据布局、验证合规性等。
howto.when: 在处理BIDS数据集的对话中触发,例如整理原始数据、查询文件布局、验证是否符合规范等。

say.text: 我的数据现在很乱,帮我整理成BIDS结构。
say.note: Claude会给出目录和文件命名建议。

say.text: 这有一批DICOM文件,怎么转成BIDS?
say.note: Claude会给出转换命令和步骤。

say.text: 帮我验证这个数据集是否符合BIDS规范。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude processes BIDS-related requests: organizing neuroimaging/behavioral files per spec, querying data layouts, and validating compliance.
howto.when_en: When the conversation involves BIDS datasets, e.g., organizing raw data, querying file layouts, validating compliance, etc.

say_en.text: My data is messy; help me organize it into BIDS structure.
say_en.note: Claude suggests folder and file naming.
